(Section)

The saying of Isaiah also about Makkah, may Allah exalt it: "Behold, I will give to the desert the glory of Lebanon, and in it is the treasure, wealth."

He said: "They are the Levant (al-Sham) and Bayt al-Maqdis." He means: I will make the glory that was there through revelation and the appearance of the prophets, a prelude to the Prophet ﷺ, and to the Hajj.

Then he said: "Waters and streams will cleave the desert in a barren land, and in the wastelands and the thirsty places there will be springs and waters, and there will be a highway and a road of the Sanctuary, which unclean nations will not pass through. Whoever is ignorant of it will not reach it there, and there will be no beasts of prey or lions in it, and there will be a passage for the sincere."

The saying of Isaiah in his book also concerning the Sanctuary: "Indeed the wolf and the lamb graze together in it," an indication of its security, which Allah singles out for it over the other lands of the earth. For this reason He named it "the secure land," and He said: ﴿Do they not see that We have made a sanctuary secure, while people are snatched away from around them?﴾

And He said, enumerating His blessings upon its people: ﴿For the accustomed security of the Quraysh, their accustomed security in the caravan of winter and summer, let them worship the Lord of this House, who has fed them against hunger and secured them against fear.﴾
